nodes.label: Shared Form Component
nodes.rationale: Used for uniform, consistent field styling across the whole app.

nodes.label: Nutritionist Name Prompt
nodes.rationale: Rendered when nutritionist row missing; lets them insert a row with their name to get started.

nodes.label: Dashboard Onboarding Gate (clients, subscription, name)
nodes.rationale: Index blocks and manages the flow of client creation, subscription and nutritionist name before routing.

nodes.label: Clients Sorted by Upcoming Planning
nodes.rationale: Sorting by whether clients have planning for upcoming days lets nutritionists prioritize clients needing immediate attention.

nodes.label: Generate Supabase Types Workflow
nodes.rationale: On push to main or manual dispatch, runs 'supabase gen types typescript --project-id iivsjutltecehnnhmjok' and writes src/services/supabase/types.ts so DB types stay in sync.

nodes.label: EzFood HTML Entry (index.html)
nodes.rationale: Mounts #root and loads /src/main.tsx as module entry point.

nodes.label: create-stripe-checkout Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Replaces customer_email checkout that created a new Customer every time; reuses/creates Customer with metadata.supabase_user_id, blocks duplicate subscriptions, validates redirect URLs against ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

nodes.label: create-stripe-portal Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Self-heals Customer metadata and derives return_url from Origin instead of defaulting to localhost:5173.

nodes.label: has_active_subscription() (02_subscription.sql)
nodes.rationale: Old version joined via subscriptions.metadata which is missing for subscriptions created outside checkout; new one uses customer metadata.supabase_user_id with subscriptions.metadata fallback. Apply before 01 trigger.

nodes.label: 01_seats_trigger.sql (tr_sync_stripe_seats on all_users)
nodes.rationale: Old trigger sent net.http_post without auth (silent 401) and fired on any UPDATE of all_users; new one reads seat_sync_secret and seat_sync_apikey from Vault rather than embedding them in pg_catalog-readable function source.

nodes.label: update-stripe-amount Edge Function (seat sync)
nodes.rationale: Previously an empty file so billed seats never updated. Deployed with --no-verify-jwt because Postgres calls it; protected by X-Sync-Secret (SEAT_SYNC_SECRET). Uses proration_behavior create_prorations.

nodes.label: Nutritionist Access to Client Data
nodes.rationale: Core feature: the assigned nutritionist has a dedicated account and can view client food logs and metrics, limited to providing dietary advice under professional confidentiality.

nodes.label: Supabase Data Storage in France (GDPR)
nodes.rationale: Data hosted by Supabase in France so it falls under GDPR; account deletion permanently removes data immediately, local cache cleared within 15-30 minutes.

nodes.label: Tech Stack: React 18 + TS, Vite/SWC, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query v5, React Router v6
nodes.norm_label: tech stack: react 18 + ts, vite/swc, redux toolkit, tanstack query v5, react router v6

nodes.label: Nutritionist Subscription Paywall
nodes.rationale: After completing nutritionist profile the paywall blocks inviting clients until subscription is active; frontend polls up to 60s for the webhook after checkout.

nodes.label: Tiered Seat Pricing (Stripe price, quantity = clients)
nodes.norm_label: tiered seat pricing (stripe price, quantity = clients)
nodes.rationale: Single plan; amount derives from quantity: 5 EUR/month up to 5 clients, then 25 EUR/month + 2 EUR per client. Tiers must be configured in the Stripe Price (billing_scheme tiered), not in code.

nodes.label: Rollup Visualizer Bundle Stats (stats.html)
nodes.rationale: Generated bundle-size report from rollup-plugin-visualizer for the Vite build.

nodes.label: Stripe-Supabase Integration Deployment Guide
nodes.rationale: Not yet deployed; web code already assumes these changes. Fixes paywall and customer portal bugs from the old supabase/intagration versions.

nodes.label: Image Content-Security-Policy (ezfood.fit, Supabase storage)
nodes.rationale: Restricts img-src to self, data:, blob:, https://ezfood.fit and the Supabase project host so only app and storage images load.

nodes.label: Stripe Customer metadata.supabase_user_id Backfill
nodes.rationale: Must run before replacing has_active_subscription() or paying nutritionists get locked out; metadata is written in Stripe and mirrored to stripe.customers by the sync engine. Only non-reversible but additive step.

nodes.norm_label: weekly day selector (mon-sun pills, month header)

nodes.label: App Calendar Screenshot (mobile daily plan view)
nodes.norm_label: app calendar screenshot (mobile daily plan view)

nodes.label: Carbohidratos por hora de entrenamiento
nodes.rationale: Section listing grams of carbs per training hour (1h-5h) per day, plus Kcal de entrenamiento; Saturday shows a long session (100/150/60/20 g) versus 60 g/h on other days.

nodes.label: Macronutrientes diarios (carbs per kg)
nodes.rationale: Daily macronutrient rows such as Carbohidratos/kg (6.40-7.43) with a Promedio semanal weekly average column (6.71).

nodes.label: Balance energetico (daily and weekly)
nodes.rationale: Daily kcal energy balance per weekday (e.g. 1491-2659 kcal) with a Balance semanal total column (11971 kcal); the peak day coincides with the longest training day.

nodes.label: Dark-green tabular dashboard layout
nodes.rationale: Spreadsheet-like layout with dark-green headers and row labels, light cells, section header bands spanning the week, and a right-hand weekly summary column; Spanish UI served at localhost:5173/#/dashboard (Vite dev server, hash routing).

nodes.label: Meal Codes (CC / DES level)
nodes.rationale: Meals are referenced by compact category+level codes (e.g. CC 2 for dinner, DES 1 for snack); higher levels appear on high-demand days (Saturday DES 3), suggesting intake level scales with training load.

nodes.label: Weekly Meal Plan Grid (meal slots x weekdays)
nodes.norm_label: weekly meal plan grid (meal slots x weekdays)
nodes.rationale: Rows are meal slots (Entrenamiento de tarde, Cena, Picar, Pre entrenamiento, Recuperador, Merienda) and columns are weekdays Lunes-Domingo; each cell shows a meal code such as CC 2 or DES 1, with colored borders highlighting variants (e.g. CC 3 / DES 3).

nodes.label: Client Invite Code
nodes.rationale: Nutritionist invites using the exact code the client gives them, plus a message.

nodes.label: Pending Invitations List
nodes.rationale: Invitations expire automatically after 7 days and cannot be revoked.

nodes.label: Invitation 7-Day Auto Expiry
nodes.rationale: Invitations are not revocable; they simply expire after 7 days, avoiding a revoke flow.

nodes.label: Configurable Keyboard Shortcuts
nodes.rationale: Each shortcut is reassigned by pressing a new key on its field; stored in global config state.

nodes.label: Week Cloning via Drag and Drop
nodes.norm_label: week cloning via drag and drop

nodes.label: Planning Day Preset
nodes.rationale: Standard planning days saved (recipes, carbs per training hour, comment) to be loaded later into planning; old presets can be deleted.

nodes.label: Drag Listeners Only on Grip Handle
nodes.norm_label: drag listeners only on grip handle
nodes.rationale: Drag listeners exist only on the GripVertical handle so they do not interfere with normal day-selection clicks.

nodes.label: O(1) Map Lookup of Planning Data
nodes.norm_label: o(1) map lookup of planning data
nodes.rationale: planningQuery.data is processed into a Map to avoid calling .find() 42 times per render.

nodes.label: Instant Week Selection via YYYY-MM-DD String Set
nodes.norm_label: instant week selection via yyyy-mm-dd string set
nodes.rationale: Comparing YYYY-MM-DD strings in a Set<string> instead of native Date instances prevents the green strip from flickering or not painting on mount.

nodes.label: Autoscroll Selected Row
nodes.rationale: selectedRowKey is a string derived from content, so column changes or rows rebuilt after refetch do not trigger scrolling; first render skipped via hasMountedRef.

nodes.label: Row Lookup by Content Equality
nodes.rationale: selectCell finds the row via getCellId('') equality rather than index/reference because rows are rebuilt with new instances whenever queries revalidate.

nodes.label: Sticky Label Column Layout
nodes.rationale: First column is sticky left-0 so the label stays visible on horizontal scroll; 7 day columns share space equally.

nodes.label: App Store Publication Compliance
nodes.rationale: Privacy policy and references pages are required to publish the app on the App Store and meet privacy regulations.

nodes.label: Raw-State Ingredient Macro Assumption
nodes.rationale: Ingredient macros are computed for the raw, unprepared standard description (e.g. raw hake fillet) unless stated; a cooked-to-raw weight conversion tool helps approximate. Values are a reference guide only, not exact.

nodes.label: EZ FOOD Logo (favicon vite.svg)
nodes.description: 48x48 square brand mark: white background, large gray (#737373) 'EZ' letters with an underline bar, and small dark (#3f3d47) letters 'F','O','O','D' stacked vertically on the right, reading 'EZ FOOD'. Includes an embedded masked PNG layer. Served from public/ as the app favicon, replacing the default Vite logo while keeping the vite.svg filename.
nodes.rationale: Keeps the default Vite filename so index.html's favicon link keeps working without changes, while showing the nutrition app's own branding.

nodes.label: EZ FOOD Brand Identity
nodes.description: Product name/brand 'EZ FOOD' (easy food) for the nutrition web app, using a neutral gray and dark-slate palette.

nodes.label: .expo Folder (Expo dev artifacts)
nodes.rationale: Created by 'expo start'; holds machine-specific devices.json, packager-info.json, settings.json and should not be committed (gitignored).
